thread:
sam.k: heads up — model-serving in us-west1 behind the ALB is returning 502s and healthchecks are flapping since ~08:12 UTC. anyone touching NAT/SG/NACLs?
lee.ops: seeing it too. k8s liveness probes failing on 8080 but pods look fine when queried directly. ALB healthcheck logs show connection reset from ALB IP -> pod node:172.31.x.x:32768
maria: could be a NACL ephemeral port block. i remember we tightened ephemeral ranges for edge NAT last week (ticket INF-1099).
chris: pulling up NACL history now. if it's inbound deny on 32768-61000 that would explain ALB->pod replies being dropped. giving a quick check.
deploy-bot: Deployment model-serving/us-west1 v14 -> v15 started at 08:23 UTC
lee.ops: before we flip rules, quick sanity check: tcpdump on node shows outbound SNAT from pod src=172.31.9.12:32768 -> dst=8.8.8.8:53 and replies are targeted to nat eip 18.0.0.5:32768 which NACL inbound is dropping. looks like NAT port reuse + restrictive inbound NACL = dropped healthcheck responses.
maria: here's the offending NACL snippet i found in the audit logs: ```nacl-0a1b2c rules: DENY IN 32768-65535 0.0.0.0/0 priority 100 allow-out 1024-32767```
chris: confirmed. i'm going to relax the inbound ephemeral range for the ALB subnet (nacl-0a1b2c) to allow 32768-61000 just for the ALB CIDR, will restrict back after we verify. PR #4521 open.
sam.k: can we do a fast mitigation that doesn't involve infra changes? eg change target-group health check port to 80 and path /hc so responses come back on known ports?
lee.ops: i can switch TG health check to port 80/path /hc now (it's quick). doing it, will wait one interval.
maria: switching done. TG shows healthchecks initialising.
lee.ops: healthchecks started succeeding. ALB target shows 8/10 -> 10/10 healthy within 45s. :tada:
chris: NACL change confirmed and logged. i'll coordinate a tighter allow rule scoped to ALB ENIs and file follow-up with security for controlled exception. creating INF-1122 with context.
sam.k: great catch everyone. root cause = NACL inbound ephemeral deny + NAT port reuse causing ALB healthcheck replies to be dropped. add to postmortem and run a config audit to catch similar tightened NACLs in other regions.
oncall: incident updated to SEV3, tagging @security and @netops. will follow up in the postmortem thread.
